name: even gaps and final-line padding
test:
result = fullJustify(['This', 'is', 'an', 'example', 'of', 'text', 'justification.'], 16)
assert result == ['This    is    an', 'example  of text', 'justification.  ']
print(repr(result))

name: leftmost gap gets extra space
test:
result = fullJustify(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'], 6)
assert result == ['a  b c', 'd     ']
print(repr(result))

name: single-word nonfinal line
test:
result = fullJustify(['long', 'a', 'bc'], 4)
assert result == ['long', 'a bc']
print(repr(result))
